import re


urls = [
    'https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+do+things&q=guides',
    'https://www.bing.com/search?q=test+query+2',
    'https://search.yahoo.com/search?p=guide'
]

search_engine_regex = re.compile(r'(www\.)?google|bing|yahoo\.com|example\.com')

search_engines = set()

for url in urls:
    if search_engine_regex.match(url):
        search_engines.add(url)

search_engines = sorted(list(search_engines))
print(search_engines)
